tags: KABA E-Plex 5000 Series Electronic Pushbutton Locks

text.description_html:
KABA E5010S E-Plex Electronic Keypad Exit Device Trim

The KABA E-Plex pushbutton lock eliminates the problems and cost associated with issuing, controlling and collecting keys and cards. Provides exterior access by combination, while allowing free egress with exit device. Easy to install, program and maintain.

Up to 100 user codes available per door. Each code has 5 access levels. The last 3,000 lock events including the use of key override are stored in memory.

Locks are programmed via keypad or with optional Microsoft Excel-based software. Simplifies management of doors and users as facility's number of users and access points grow.

Features of KABA E5010S

  • Includes Key Override
  • 100 User Code PIN Access Control
  • 3,000 Event Audit Trail
  • Audible and visual indicators, low battery visual indicator
  • 5 Authority Access Levels
  • Heavy Duty - ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 (highest grade)
  • SCEC Endorsed
  • 3 Hour Fire Door Rating
  • No wiring to or through the door
  • Tested -35° F (-35° C) to +130° F (55° C) Indoor/Outdoor Use
  • 180,000 Cycles - Battery 4xAA
  • 3 Year Warranty

Specifications of KABA E5010S

  • Construction: Extra heavy-duty, solid cast housings, solid cast door levers, wear tested for extensive use in indoor and outdoor applications.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Minimum Stile: 5"
  • Installation: Easily installs on wood or metal doors
  • Handing: Non-handed, field reversible.
  • Numeric Keypad: Vandal resistant, 12-button metal keys.
  • Fire Rating: Three (3) hour UL/ULC fire door rating.
  • ADA Compliant
  • Warranty: Three (3) Year warranty from date of installation.
  • Finish: US26D (626) Satin Chrome

A KABA lock cylinder (Schlage "C" compatible) is included. Best I/C compatible lever is optional (Best cylinder NOT included).

**Exterior trim only. Exit device sold separately.**
